steps.title: Start the dev server
steps.reason: Use this after dependencies are installed.

profiles.label: Next.js app
profiles.reason: Next.js app — deploy to VPS with Node >=18

vps.title: Install Node.js on VPS
vps.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs

vps.title: Clone and install on VPS
vps.command: git clone <your-repo> ~/apps/stealth-v26 && cd ~/apps/stealth-v26 && npm install && npm run build

vps.title: Run with PM2 (keeps bot/server alive)
vps.reason: PM2 restarts on crash and survives SSH disconnect.
vps.command: pm2 start npm run start --name stealth-v26

vps.title: Persist PM2 across reboots
vps.reason: Run once after first PM2 start.

hints: Long-running bot — use PM2 on VPS
